items.title: 8.16 Chemical equilibrium ke sanati istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 8.16, printed page 183.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 8.16.1 shuru karti hai. Industry ki bunyadi zaroorat yeh hai ke product ki zyada se zyada yield mile, aur equilibrium ka concept batata hai ke yeh kaise hasil ho. Do aham reversible reactions parhenge: Haber process se ammonia (8.16.1) aur contact process mein sulphuric acid ke liye sulphur trioxide (8.16.2). Dono exothermic gas reactions hain; in ke halaat Le Chatelier ke principle aur munasib raftar (rate) dono ko dekh kar chune jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Dono industrial processes woh temperature kyun nahi istemal karte jo sab se zyada yield deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono reactions exothermic hain, is liye kam temperature par Kc bara aur yield zyada hoti hai, magar raftar itni sust hoti hai ke kaam mehnga (uneconomical) ho jata hai. Is liye darmiyana temperature aur catalyst istemal hota hai: munasib waqt mein qabil-e-qabool yield milti hai.

items: Industry zyada yield chahti hai; Haber aur contact process Le Chatelier ka principle (pressure, temperature, product nikalna) aur catalyst dono istemal karte hain.
